thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — FinServ security pre-call at 10am PT tomorrow. They sent a checklist: RBAC matrix, audit log export format, KMS key provenance, key rotation evidence, vuln triage timeline, and IR playbook. Can we prepare short answers and artifacts?
aj: I can own the RBAC matrix. Will export a minimal CSV and a paragraph on our scoping rules. Anyone have the latest mapping of service accounts -> roles?
jules: I have the policy dump from last week. I'll trim to tenant-scoped entries. Do we want to show sample DB rows or just role table?
maria: sample role table + one example tenant mapping should be enough. They usually want the principle-of-least-priv proof, not full DB.
sam: On KMS: hosted uses AWS KMS (CMK), dedicated/private can use customer-managed CMKs or HSM. For the call, we should note: key origin, envelope encryption flow, rotation cadence, and access audit. I can write a short diagram.
carol: FinServ asked specifically if keys are ever exported off AWS or persisted in plaintext by us. We need a clear no-export statement and the technical rationale.
aj: Draft snippet: "We never export CMK private material outside the KMS provider. For hosted we use AWS KMS CMKs; for private deployments customers may supply keys via their KMS/HSM. Data keys are generated and used transiently; decrypted material is not persisted outside secure enclave processes." Feedback?
jules: +1. Maybe add: "All key usage is logged to KMS/CloudTrail; we map CloudTrail events to our audit logs for tenant correlation."
maria: Good. Also include how we tie key usage to tenant_id in logs — useful for their compliance auditors. Jules, can you include an example CloudTrail -> internal log mapping?
jules: Yep. I'll paste a short example: 
```
cloudtrail: PutKeyEvent { userIdentity: service/redwood-inference, requestParameters: { keyId: arn:aws:kms:... }, eventTime: 2025-11-12T14:22:01Z }
internal-log: kms.key_use tenant_id=acct_123 key_id=... actor=redwood-service time=2025-11-12T14:22:01Z
```
maria: perfect.
security-bot: Reminder: attach the latest rotation proof CSV (rotation_dates.csv) and KMS access control docs to the thread before EOD.
aj: I'm assembling RBAC CSV now. Quick Q: do we show service-account tokens or just role bindings?
maria: only role bindings and the least-priv description. No tokens or secrets.
carol: Also need to confirm log retention windows and exportability. FinServ has 7-year retention requirements in some cases. Can we give them a max retention + export path?
sam: For hosted we retain tenant-level audit logs for 13 months by default, longer with an add-on. For Dedicated/Private, retention is customer-configurable — they can ship logs to their SIEM via our export hooks (S3/HTTPS/Syslog). I'll draft the export steps.
aj: For vuln triage/IR they asked for SLA on patching and a timeline example. We typically do critical CVE remediation within 72 hours for infra-facing issues and 30 days for app-medium. Want me to write that?
maria: Yes, include our classification matrix and a short description of the incident response flow (detect, triage, mitigate, notify, postmortem). Attach a sanitized example of a past triage timeline (no PII).
jules: I can redact an old timeline and attach.
carol: Any objections to offering a 3rd-party attestation (SOC2 summary) in the packet? They asked for evidence.
maria: Provide SOC2 summary + link to our compliance pack. For more sensitive accounts we'll do NDA+SAS.
security-bot: Action items: @aj prepare RBAC CSV (due EOD), @jules prepare cloudtrail->internal log mapping + redacted triage timeline (due EOD), @sam prepare KMS diagram + export instructions (due EOD), @maria assemble packet and run final review (due tomorrow 9am).
aj: Acknowledged. Will upload CSV to the shared drive and post link here.
jules: Uploading mapping file to drive now: https://redwood.drive/finserv-artifacts/rbac-and-logs (placeholder)
sam: Draft KMS diagram attached in drive too.
maria: Great work. Final ask: keep answers concise — their auditor prefers bullet points. We'll meet 9:30am PT to finalize.
carol: I'll be on the call to handle contract/security questions.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
